[[Cleansing the Silent Surf (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Cleansing the Silent Surf.jpg|250px]] | map1text = From [[Unwaking Waters (Luxon)]] }} Fight with the [[Ministry of Purity]] to eradicate the [[Afflicted]] in their last stand in the [[Silent Surf]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Defeat the Afflicted in the Silent Surf. * See [[Initiate Zei Ri]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,000 [[Experience]] *500 [[Gold]] *[[Ministerial Commendation]] ===Environmental changes=== * Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in [[Silent Surf (Winds of Change)|Silent Surf]], specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn. ==Walkthrough== There are 2-3 waves with several groups in each wave. The groups in each wave stagger from each other, but do overlap. It is easy to get quickly overwhelmed. Fortunately, there is a resurrection shrine nearby, either at the entrance if aligned with the [[Luxon]]s or on the island to the northeast if aligned with the [[Kurzick]]s. However, you can stay away from where the Afflicted converge and [[pull]] foes away from the area to make the encounter less deadly. You do not need to kill all the afflicted to complete this quest. This quest can be completed by only killing five (1-5) groups of Afflicted: Start from [[Unwaking Waters (Luxon)]], hug the west (left) wall towards the boats, and flag your team near the Mob (3) spawn point. Pull the starting Mob (1); once eliminated, use [[speed boost]]s to swiftly aggro Mob (2) that spawns near/behind one of the further boats before it moves to the center. After these are killed, Mob (3) will spawn behind you, near the ''original'' flag-point. Mob (4) will spawn right behind the boat that's closest to you. The last group, Mob (5), spawn relatively far away to the east of your likely location, but will move towards the boats before moving towards the center. After killing this group, the quest should be completed. AoE skills are recommended. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Humans]] ([[Ministry of Purity]]) *{{rt}} 28 (28) [[Initiate Zei Ri]] *{{w}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Enforcer]] *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Enforcer]] *{{r}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Ranger]] *{{r}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Ranger]] *{{mo}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Cleric]] *{{mo}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Cleric]] *{{n}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Purger]] *{{n}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Purger]] *{{me}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Illusionist]] *{{me}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Illusionist]] *{{e}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Mage]] *{{e}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Mage]] *{{a}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Bladesman]] *{{a}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Bladesman]] *{{rt}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Medium]] *{{rt}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Medium]] *{{p}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Zealot]] *{{p}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Captain]] *{{d}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Captain]] *{{d}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Zealot]] ===Foes=== [[Afflicted]] *{{w}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Warrior]] *{{r}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Ranger]] *{{mo}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Monk]] *{{n}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Necromancer]] *{{me}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Mesmer]] *{{e}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Elementalist]] *{{a}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Assassin]] *{{rt}} 24, 26 (26, 28) [[Afflicted Ritualist]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Initiate Zei Ri :''"This is our last battle here on [[the Jade Sea]], but this won't be easy. The Afflicted have massed in incredible numbers at the '''Silent Surf'''. Other members of the [[Ministry of Purity]] are traveling there, as well. It's a futile effort, though. For the good of everyone, we will put them to rest. Will you fight with us?"'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = We'll win this one together. | decline = I think you guys have it covered. | ask = Members of the Ministry of Purity are gathering at the '''Silent Surf'''.
